tagline: Schema status and migrations for remote teammates — migrate-dev needs your approval.
requirements: No catalog setup; the server reads the host's Prisma project (schema and DATABASE_URL from the project directory). This is the official MCP mode of the Prisma CLI, launched via the `mcp` subcommand. Launch it from the project root.

tools.name: migrate-status
tools.note: Reports migration status for the project.

tools.name: migrate-dev
tools.note: Creates and applies migrations — changes the development database schema.

tools.name: Prisma-Studio
tools.note: Launches Prisma Studio to browse the database — its contents surface to the guest.

seo.description: Share the official Prisma MCP server with MCPWire. Let teammates check migration status over P2P, and keep schema migrations and database browsing behind approval.
